row.reason: AMETEK is a diversified maker of analytical, test and measurement instruments plus electromechanical components, interconnects and thermal systems, sold to aerospace, medical, power, research and industrial customers. Mirion is a specialist in radiation detection, measurement and dosimetry, with nuclear, medical and defense customers. The two overlap in precision measurement instruments and in some end markets: medical, power, research and defense. Mirion covers only the instrumentation slice of AMETEK. It has no motors, connectors, specialty metals or thermal management, and its customer base is narrower and centered on nuclear. Both are instrument makers that earn money from product sales plus services. Because Mirion matches only one of AMETEK's material businesses, the score is capped at 1.
